codeReview.summary: The commit cleanly updates rewrite-worker, benchmark-worker, and publication-worker SKILL guidance to match the feature’s expected behavior, including tooling-flow clarity, comparator/correctness gate rules, and publication traceability/clean-checkout requirements.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission-level AGENTS guidance still states strict red-first test workflow without the new tooling/regeneration exception language now codified in rewrite-worker, which can create conflicting interpretation for non-Rust features.

publication-worker now mandates generating/updating license inventory before license audit, but services.yaml exposes an audit command and no explicit inventory-generation command, which may reduce procedural reproducibility for workers.

rewrite-worker now covers tooling/manifest flows, but its example handoff remains Rust-parity-centric; this mismatch was also noted by the worker in skillFeedback and could still leave tooling-feature handoff expectations implicit.

summary: Pass: expected guidance alignment is implemented across all three skill files and matches the feature contract; no blocking code-review defects were found.
